_doc: Hand-scouted facts that win over the score-based guess in build.py. Keys: archetype (an id in build.py's ARCHETYPES), side (RIGHT or LEFT), lastPreloadS (seconds after PLAY, from video), source (where it was seen), note (one line for the queue). Times are ours from video traces on the scouting branch's scouting/2026/partners.json.

10255.source: video: Kentwood Q (right start, 8 matches); Fruitport playoffs beside 20245 (left start, 3 of 3); doc/partner-autos-belding-fruitport.md (our partner runs, video)
10255.note: Takes either start. Beside our R-NoCross it started LEFT every time: first volley 4.3-6.4 s, a second volley 14-15 s into the LEFT CELL (TIP 2 in 2 of 3), on its start to 15-18 s, then the corner. At Kentwood it started RIGHT, last preload ~2.1 s.

11846.note: Right corner (10, 12), volley from (26, 13.5) ~3-6.5 s (its TIP swung 8-10 s), wall FLOWER pick ~11 s, second volley ~18 s, then parks. Slow first TIP: set the wait long.

11228.note: Starts at (31, 9) on the audience wall, three preloads, last ball ~3.8 s (2.2-4.8); its CELL tipped 4/8. Parks at the red wall (15, 98) by ~8 s, then still. Out of our way early.

15104.note: Starts beside our RIGHT_START; preloads ~1.5-3.5 s, waits on RIGHT_AUTO_HIVE (59, 21) 7-19 s, wall FLOWER, second volley ~25 s, late park. Sits on our right launch spot: never run an R- Auto beside it.

24371.note: Leave and park reliable lately (every match at its last meet). Start side not seen: ask.

10104.source: video: Belding playoffs beside 20245 (M-3, M-7, M-10); doc/partner-autos-belding-fruitport.md (our partner runs, video)
10104.note: Right start, 4 preloads, last out 1.0-1.5 s, TIP 1 at 3.7-9.8 s. Sits on its start 13-18 s, then under the HIVE: inside our CROSS AND FIX IT window, so WAIT FOR PARTNER FIX unless it promises to leave before 10 s.

5292.source: video: Belding Q-31 (LEAVE-PARK, left start) and playoffs M-4, M-7, M-9, M-10 beside 19429 (right start); doc/partner-autos-belding-fruitport.md (our partner runs, video)
5292.note: Playoffs: right start, 6-7 preloads, last out 2.5-4.8 s, TIP 1 at 4.1-10.3 s, leaves its start 5.5-8 s (clear of our cross). In quals it ran a LEAVE-PARK from the left start.

8513.source: video: Belding M-1, M-6 beside 19429; doc/partner-autos-belding-fruitport.md (our partner runs, video)
8513.note: Right start at the audience corner; M-1: 4 shots at the RIGHT CELL 1.9-5.3 s, all missed. Left along the alliance wall at 10.4 s, half a robot width from our crossing robot: WAIT FOR PARTNER FIX unless it leaves before 10 s.

18092.source: video: Belding Q-7 beside 20245; doc/partner-autos-belding-fruitport.md (our partner runs, video)
18092.note: Far (left) side, launches nothing, to the alliance wall 1.5-4.5 s.

11531.source: video: Belding Q-4 beside 20245; doc/partner-autos-belding-fruitport.md (our partner runs, video)
11531.note: At or near the left start, launches nothing, to the corner and over the LOADING ZONE by ~4 s. Pressed against our R-Solo at its park 27.5-30 s: ask it to clear our RIGHT_PARK.

6482.note: Never moved, lights on, sat in the LOADING ZONE; our park touched it 26.3-30 s. Ask it to sit in the corner past the LOADING ZONE tape.
